intelligence.essence: One page at a time. Start to FINISHED. Not 80%, not "mostly there" — completed, verified by his eye, done-done. Then the next one.
intelligence.human_view: Shawn's ruling: 'We have more incomplete work than anything. There's not one page that's been completed.' The pattern that has to die: starting five things, finishing none. A pile of 80%s is worth less than one 100%. The team doesn't need another starter — it needs a finisher. The rule: (1) Pick ONE page — Personal first, it's the master. (2) Take it from where it is to COMPLETE — every element working, every gap closed. (3) His eye verifies it. Done-done. (4) Only then: the next page. No parallel almost-dones. No 'I'll circle back.' One thing, finished, then the next. In practice: Personal — boards light up on hover, sidebars working, the stale snapshot banner gone, formatting untouched. Finished. Then Dashboard — orbs orbiting the gauge, fullscreen right. Finished. Then the morph.
intelligence.simple_view: One thing at a time, all the way to done. A pile of almosts is worth less than one finished thing. Finish, then — and only then — the next.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, it's like finishing one room of the house properly before starting the next. A whole home of half-painted rooms shelters nobody; one room done beautifully is a place to live.
intelligence.naya_view: This rule governs my queue: one item at a time to DONE — landed and proven — and nothing new starts while a started thing sits unfinished. Shawn is shown only finished things; a link sent to him is a claim of completion. Shawn's directive, 2026-11-05 ~01:41Z.
intelligence.ai_view: Execution rule: WIP limit = 1 per finisher chain. State machine per item: started -> landed -> proven -> done; transitions require evidence (merge proof for landed, live-surface check for proven). New starts blocked while any item is in started/landed state. Reporting: completed items only.
intelligence.machine_view: wip_limit=1; order=[personal_master, dashboard, morph_clones]; done=landed+proven_live+his_eye; forbidden=[parallel_almost_done, circle_back]; source=SN-0892
